criteria.statement: Fresh GitHub repository identity, default branch, base commit, and base tree match the approved checkpoint.
Execution uses a clean isolated worktree and branch created directly from the approved base.
No concurrent or overlapping unreviewed pull request or branch affects Stage 1 authority paths.
Part 1 completion, historical tests, and protected artifact digests are verified.
Cross-project isolation passes without foreign-project contamination.
The Part 2 completion contract and Stage 1 acceptance registry validate fail closed.
Frozen historical Part 1 validation and current-tree preservation are separate and both pass.
Every dependency and image is pinned, authorized, inventoried, and provenance reviewed.
Two clean bootstraps succeed without undeclared dependencies or ambient services.
Real PostgreSQL logical replication and exported-snapshot capability are proven.
Every governed source table has a versioned contract, catalog entry, canonical digest, and migration checksum.
Workload identity canonically includes seed, schema set, operation plan, schedule, driver version, and canonicalization profile.
Logical workload identity excludes physical LSN, ambient time, host/container identity, and temporary paths.
The source-workload-v1 lifecycle and additive specification/receipt split are explicit.
All required workload cases execute, including abort and controlled schema change.
Concurrent writers use an explicit deterministic commit schedule.
Source history preserves transaction boundaries, order, before/after state, schema identity, and expected state.
Two clean same-seed runs produce identical logical plans, histories, and state digests.
A different seed changes workload identity and history without changing schema meaning.
Independent replay and queried PostgreSQL state have identical table and whole-state digests.
Frontier S is returned by a qualified exported logical snapshot procedure.
The snapshot transaction imports the exact exported snapshot while its exporter remains valid.
Exactly one immutable typed PostgreSQL LSN frontier is bound to the generation.
The LSN comparator is versioned, numeric, property tested, and fail closed.
The boundary receipt binds source, database, server/image, slot/plugin, workload, generation, schema, snapshot, and frontier identities.
Snapshot counts and canonical table and whole-state digests are produced inside the imported transaction.
The first eligible post-boundary transaction commit is strictly greater than S.
Gap, overlap, exact-S, regression, identity mismatch, expired snapshot, and reused-boundary cases fail closed.
Aborted source transactions never enter committed history or expected snapshot state.
Physical LSN variability is run evidence and is excluded from semantic determinism.
Static, typing, unit, property, contract, integration, negative, historical, and preservation layers pass.
Coverage remains at or above 85 percent without artificial exclusions.
Evidence schemas and manifest digests validate exactly.
Evidence contains no credentials, connection strings, host/container IDs, absolute paths, or raw ephemeral identifiers.
Requirements and claims advance only to directly supported local evidence.
The diff contains only authorized Stage 1 files and declared dependencies/images.
The exact pull-request head passes every local gate and required GitHub check without bypass or stale result.
The reviewed head is merged under existing policy and fresh main matches the expected commit and tree.
Bounded post-merge validation, Part 1 preservation, evidence integrity, and cleanup pass on merged main.
An external PART2_STAGE1_SOURCE_BOUNDARY_VERIFIED checkpoint defines the exact Stage 2 entry contract.
